name: Orbit AI - Phase 2 - No-show re-engagement (05 Section 3, new - not brief-W-numbered)

nodes.name: No-show webhook
nodes.notes: 05 Section 3: 'No-show re-engagement: auto-fires rebooking outreach draft.' Meant to be called the moment a Demo's ScheduledTouch (unified-scheduling.workflow.json) is dispositioned 'NoShow' - nothing in this repo currently dispositions a ScheduledTouch (that's a Deals Desk UI action, not built - see the tracked Deals Desk task), so this is real, callable logic waiting on that caller, same status as several other workflows built this pass. Input contract: {opportunityId, companyName, contactName}.

nodes.name: Draft rebooking outreach

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: 'claude-opus-5', max_tokens: 512, system: [{ type: 'text', text: 'You draft short, friendly rebooking outreach messages for a sales team after a prospect no-shows a demo. One or two sentences, no guilt-tripping, a clear next step (reply with times that work). This is a DRAFT for a human rep to review and send - never implies it has already been sent.', cache_control: { type: 'ephemeral' } }], messages: [{ role: 'user', content: 'Company: ' + $json.body.companyName + '\nContact: ' + ($json.body.contactName || 'unknown') + '\nThey no-showed a scheduled demo. Draft a rebooking message.' }] }) }}

nodes.notes: Drafts only, never sends - per the automation risk boundary, an outbound message to a lead is an external send and stays human-gated (same rule W2.2/W2.3's nurture/CX cadence already follow). Same Claude credential/header pattern as every other real Claude call in this repo.

nodes.name: Log draft to Activity Event

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ type: 'RebookingDraft', opportunityId: $('No-show webhook').item.json.body.opportunityId, draftText: $json.draftText, at: new Date().toISOString() }) }}

nodes.notes: Same Activity Event timeline every other draft/log write in this repo uses - a rep opening the Opportunity sees the draft sitting there, ready to copy/send or edit, not buried in an email inbox somewhere.

nodes.name: Alert: rebooking draft ready

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ severity: 'info', source: 'no-show-reengagement', message: 'No-show rebooking draft ready for ' + $('No-show webhook').item.json.body.companyName + '.', linkUrl: ($env.TWENTY_CRM_BASE_URL || '') + '/objects/opportunity/' + $('No-show webhook').item.json.body.opportunityId }) }}

nodes.notes: Routes to #demos (alertRouting.ts's channelForSource matches 'no-show'/'reengagement' in the source string) - a rep watching that channel sees the draft is ready without needing to poll the Opportunity themselves.
